fairIIDZeroJackpot.assumptions: Fair independent draws; each round has g distinct valid tickets selected before that draw. Choices may adapt to past draws.

primaryMethodologySources.title: Gneiting and Raftery (2007), Strictly Proper Scoring Rules, Prediction, and Estimation
primaryMethodologySources.supports: The logarithmic score evaluates a predictive distribution at the realized outcome; proper scoring rules encourage reporting the true predictive distribution.

primaryMethodologySources.title: Romano and Tirlea, Permutation Testing for Dependence in Time Series
primaryMethodologySources.supports: Permutation exactness holds under an i.i.d. or exchangeable null; it does not generally hold under merely uncorrelated time-series nulls.

primaryMethodologySources.title: Shafer (2021), Testing by Betting: A Strategy for Statistical and Scientific Communication
primaryMethodologySources.supports: Successive likelihood ratios form a nonnegative martingale; sequential probability assignments must precede the realized outcomes.

limitations: Fair-IID quantities are mathematical baselines, not claims that fairness or independence was proved by this sample.
All 522 full-six antecedent sets are distinct; this dataset contains no replicated exact full-six antecedent from which a corresponding six-to-six conditional distribution can be directly estimated.
A pair-conditioned model of each future number does not estimate arbitrary future-pair or full-six interactions.
Overlap support counts describe eligible historical sources, not independent causal interventions. Weighted similarity totals are not automatically an effective independent sample size.
The last 104 historical draws have already been examined in earlier experiments. New comparisons there are exploratory reuse, not a fresh holdout.
Shuffling entire six-number draw rows and rerunning the full fixed analysis preserves within-draw constraints under an exchangeable null; shuffling already-built lag rows is a different procedure.
After selecting the best model or lag, inference must account for that selection; a fixed-family correction does not erase all prior data exploration.
A joint logarithmic score improvement or its exponential is not a proven multiplier of purchased-ticket jackpot probability.
Prospective evidence accumulation must begin after this exploratory analysis with saved pre-draw predictions; it cannot retroactively validate data-informed model choices.
